test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the full form of RIDF?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rural Infrastructure Development Fund**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Rural Infrastructure Development Fund (RIDF)** was established by the Government of India in **1995-96 **to finance rural infrastructure projects.
 
• Managed by the **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD),** the RIDF provides loans to state governments and state-owned corporations for public sector capital investment in rural infrastructure.
 
• The fund supports **39 eligible activities**, categorized into three broad areas: **Agriculture and related sectors, Social sector, and Rural connectivity.**
 
• Domestic commercial banks contribute to the RIDF if they fall short of their priority sector lending targets for agriculture.
 
• As a result, the RIDF has become a crucial source of public capital formation for rural infrastructure development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The discrepancy between **disbursements of RIDF **funds and sanctioned amounts continues to be a concern in its implementation.
 
• To tackle this issue, the Government has implemented various measures.
 
• One significant step is the expansion of the **scope of RIDF** to include a broader range of activities.
 
• This expansion encompasses initiatives such as rural drinking water schemes, soil conservation projects, rural market yards, rural health centers, primary schools, mini hydel plants, shishu shiksha kendras, anganwadis, and system improvements in the power sector.
